scenario: read canonical-backed content with a truncated History source spill using the current PKG payload modules

runtime.source: arm64 PKG payload app.asar loaded by its Electron binary in ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE mode

damage.operation: truncate generated source copy to one half of its descriptor length

damagedRead.implementation: readChatPageAfterPreparation exported from current app.asar dist-electron/electron/sessionStorage/public/readMessages.js; createSqliteSessionStorage backed by the same app.asar database module

limitations: single synthetic identity-clone sample; no PKG installation
used the current packaged shared read modules through ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, not the packaged renderer IPC or UI
valid and damaged profiles were separate clones; damaged profile remains an isolated test fixture
does not cover spill deletion, same-length digest corruption, malformed locator, publish-boundary fault, real history, or baseline comparison
does not close AC-7 or P4-02/P4-03
